title: MSSP Multi-Tenant Readiness Foundation
goal: Prepare commercial scaling for MSSP and multi-tenant use without weakening isolation or current operator workflows.
scope: Create the first MSSP/multi-tenant readiness slice by mapping current engagement, customer, run, finding, report, secret, and artifact boundaries to required tenant isolation rules. Implement only a narrow foundation if the current model supports it safely.
generation_reason: Product recommendation coverage audit found MSSP/multi-tenant support was present in recommendations but not queued.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Readiness and narrow isolation foundation only. Do not launch hosted SaaS, billing, or broad RBAC unless explicitly promoted later.
notes: Tenant isolation must cover artifacts, reports, secrets, and Codex results.
No cross-tenant data visibility is acceptable.

success_criteria: A repo-owned multi-tenant readiness map documents required isolation boundaries.
Any implemented foundation preserves customer/engagement isolation across API and UI paths.
Tests cover positive and cross-tenant-denied access if implementation is included.
Docs identify remaining hosted/SaaS, billing, and MSSP portal gaps.
No existing single-operator workflow is broken.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Any implementation blocks cross-tenant data access.
Hosted SaaS and billing remain out of scope unless separately promoted.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with MSSP/multi-tenant readiness changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the commercial-scaling baseline and remaining SaaS limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
